bias.en: Bearish · SAR flipped, testing the $373 October low
bias.zh: 看空 · SAR 翻空，测试 10 月 $373 低点

read.en: Applied Materials fell 4.0% on Nov 2 to $374.53, trading between $373.25 and $399.19. It is below the rising 5-day ($399.6) and 200-day ($444.8) and the falling 10-day ($395.3), 30-day ($457.0) and 100-day ($508.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Nov 2 ($426.52), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月2日下跌 4.0%，收于 $374.53，盘中区间 $373.25–399.19。股价位于上行的 5 日（$399.6）和 200 日均线（$444.8）以及下行的 10 日（$395.3）、30 日（$457.0）和 100 日均线（$508.0）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图再度扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月2日转为看空（$426.52），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke the $382.6 support and flipped the SAR bearish; the $372.8 Oct 23 low held. Resistance is $377.1–382.6 (Apr 29 and Oct 30 lows), then $395.3–399.6 (10-day, Nov 2 high, 5-day) and $405.2–409.9. Support is $372.8–373.3 (Oct 23 and Nov 2 lows), then $355.3–359 (Mar 10 and Apr 1 highs) and $338.1–344.6. A close above $382.6 would target $395–400; below $372.8, $355–359.
